decisions.reason: As a support add-on close to the firm's core hosting and service promise, management is likely to keep it because it fits the announced strategy and disappointing uptake can be explained as packaging or demand fluctuations rather than fundamental failure.

This tool builds directly on the firm's platform and software-development capabilities, and its dedicated presentation signals enough investment and public commitment that management would be inclined to continue rather than retreat.

Although the firm invested in a full product line and presented it prominently, it sits relatively far from the core hosting business, so once results disappoint it is the easiest offering to withdraw and redeploy resources from despite some escalation pressure.

Because this agency-focused hosting line is close to the core offer, has several models, and was presented as a flagship direction, management would be strongly inclined to persist with it and attribute any weaker results to temporary market or rollout factors.
